The '''Third Great Expansion''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that occurred during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the era, settlers from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] colonized outlying [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that had been surveyed and made available for settlement by laws such as the [[Colonization Act]] and the [[Planet Grant Amendment]]. One such world was the planet [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] in the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio sector]], which was colonized by the [[Muun/Legends|Muuns]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the world [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].
